name: Alistair Humphrey
bio:
Alistair Humphrey's journey into motorsport began in his youth, tinkering with engines in his father's garage. After earning a degree in mechanical engineering, he joined a Formula 3 team as a junior mechanic, quickly rising through the ranks thanks to his keen eye for detail and relentless work ethic. He transitioned into management roles, overseeing logistics and technical development for various racing outfits before landing at Lechner Racing.

Alistair's approach to operations is rooted in meticulous planning and a proactive approach to problem-solving. He believes in empowering his team, fostering a collaborative environment where innovation thrives. He's known for his ability to anticipate challenges and implement solutions before they escalate, making him a vital asset to any racing team. His visionary leadership and dedication to continuous improvement set him apart.

physical.description: Alistair is a tall, lean man with a serious demeanor and intense blue eyes.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook and pen, jotting down ideas.
Has a peculiar habit of tapping his pen against his teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on having a perfectly organized toolbox, even on race day.
